items.stem: What is the role of DMARC in email security?

options.text: It tells receivers how to handle mail that fails SPF and DKIM alignment
options.rationale: Correct: DMARC sets policy and reporting on authentication failures.

options.text: It encrypts every email in transit
options.rationale: DMARC governs authentication policy, not encryption.

options.text: It replaces the need for spam filtering
options.rationale: Filtering is still needed alongside authentication.

options.text: It guarantees no phishing will ever arrive
options.rationale: DMARC reduces spoofing but does not stop all phishing.

items.explanation: Correct: DMARC sets how receivers handle SPF/DKIM failures and adds reporting.

items.stem: Which TWO controls reduce the impact of malicious email? (Select TWO.)

options.rationale: Correct: sandboxing detonates attachments safely before users open them.

options.text: Rewriting and checking URLs at click time
options.rationale: Correct: time-of-click checks catch links that turn malicious later.

options.text: Disabling the spam filter to speed delivery
Publishing all staff passwords in the signature
options.rationale: This is an obvious and severe exposure, not a control.

items.explanation: Correct: attachment sandboxing and click-time URL checks both reduce impact.

items.stem: A phishing email is reported by a user. What should happen before deleting it everywhere?

options.text: Investigate it to find who else received it and what it does
options.rationale: Correct: analysis guides containment and scoping before removal.

options.text: Delete it instantly from all mailboxes with no analysis
options.rationale: Immediate deletion destroys evidence needed to scope the campaign.

options.text: Reply to the sender to complain
options.rationale: Replying may confirm the address is live to the attacker.

options.text: Forward it to everyone as a warning example
options.rationale: Forwarding the live email spreads the threat.

items.explanation: Correct: investigate scope and behaviour before removing it everywhere.
